elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap amount is determined using a greater-of formulation.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 caps liability at “the greater of” limbs (a) and (b).

elements.element: Limb (a) is fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses exactly “fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.” The lower-case term “fees” is undefined and potentially ambiguous beside defined “Fees,” but it literally states the required measure.

elements.element: Limb (b) is USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly provides a USD 1,000,000 second limb.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 states that “neither Party” is liable for indirect damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 states that “neither Party” is liable for consequential damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of data-protection obligations is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of security obligations is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Fraud is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability limitations.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 broadly states that “Customer's payment obligations” are not damages and are not limited by Section 21.

elements.element: The liability cap is mutual.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to each Party and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap amount is 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, so it is not a cap equal solely to 12 months' fees whenever that fee amount is below USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is carved out from the cap.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and are excluded from the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is carved out from the cap.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is carved out from the cap.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is carved out from the cap.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the Section 21.1 cap.

result.reason: The rendered clause satisfies every preferred requirement: it establishes the mutual greater-of cap, retains the mutual damages exclusion, makes all specified claims uncapped, and excludes all Customer payment obligations from damages. It does not independently satisfy the fallback's exact 12-month-fees cap because the USD 1,000,000 floor can produce a different amount. The changes are limited to the preferred cap formula and payment-obligation treatment, and unrelated terms remain operative. Drafting quality is reduced because lower-case “fees” is undefined while capitalized “Fees” remains expressly defined as only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, creating avoidable interpretive ambiguity over the fee base.
